reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and holiday adjustment helpers, but the server handlers independently reproduce the daily skip-versus-move policy implemented in getNextDate.

duplication.why: applyWeekendHandling shares logic between the two handlers, but duplicates getNextDate's frequency-dependent filtering and adjustment decision.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but the schedule-wide skip-versus-move policy is also implemented in the server application layer.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested recurrence rules, range handler, configuration propagation, and associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate separate occurrence-policy implementations and separate holiday-dependent search bounds when extending these rules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts applies its own occurrence policy through applyWeekendHandling instead of sharing getNextDate's policy; server/budget/schedule-template.ts also selects raw versus adjusted dates locally.

disguised_duplication.where: applyWeekendHandling expresses getNextDate's daily filtering and non-daily adjustment decision as a filter/map pipeline rather than its find/conditional structure.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains the holidays parameter and getNextDate gains daily-specific handling; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange use a parallel policy, while the budget occurrence loop retains local frequency dispatch and adjustment.
